title: 分词作定语
explanation: 分词（现在分词或过去分词）可充当定语修饰名词。单个分词放在名词前，分词短语放在名词后。现在分词表主动/进行，过去分词表被动/完成。分词定语相当于简化的定语从句。
rules: 单个现在分词前置：a sleeping baby（正在睡觉的婴儿）
单个过去分词前置：a broken window（被打碎的窗户）
分词短语后置：the man standing at the door（站在门口的人）
过去分词短语后置：the letter written in English（用英语写的信）
可转化为定语从句：a sleeping baby = a baby who is sleeping

examples.en: The girl singing on the stage is my sister.
examples.zh: 在舞台上唱歌的那个女孩是我姐姐。

examples.en: The book written by Mo Yan won an award.
examples.zh: 莫言写的那本书获了奖。

examples.en: I saw a man carrying a heavy box.
examples.zh: 我看到一个男人提着一个很重的箱子。

exercises.question: The man ___ (stand) at the door is my uncle.
The letter ___ (write) by hand was very beautiful.
找出错误并选择正确说法：The child sleep in the bed is my brother.
exercises.answer: The child sleeping in the bed is my brother.
options: The child sleep in the bed is my brother.
The child sleeping in the bed is my brother.
The child slept in the bed is my brother.

title: 独立主格结构
explanation: 独立主格结构是一种名词/代词 + 分词/形容词/副词/不定式/介词短语构成的结构，在句中作状语。其逻辑主语与主句主语不同，这是它与普通分词状语的关键区别。
rules: 名词/代词 + 现在分词（主动）：Weather permitting, we'll go.
名词/代词 + 过去分词（被动）：That done, we left.
名词/代词 + 形容词：He sat there, eyes closed.
名词/代词 + 介词短语：Book in hand, she entered.
名词/代词 + 不定式：So many people to help, he felt happy.

examples.en: Weather permitting, we will go on a picnic.
examples.zh: 如果天气允许，我们就去野餐。

examples.en: The work done, they went home.
examples.zh: 工作做完了，他们就回家了。

examples.en: He stood there, hands in his pockets.
examples.zh: 他站在那里，手插在口袋里。

exercises.question: Weather ___ (permit), we will have the match outdoors.
The task ___ (complete), we celebrated.
把单词排序成正确的句子（独立主格：1. All 2. things 3. considered 4. it was a good trip）。
exercises.answer: all things considered it was a good trip

title: 情态动词+have done（推测与遗憾）
explanation: 情态动词 + have + 过去分词用于对过去事件的推测、责备或表达遗憾。不同情态动词表达不同的语气强度：must（肯定推测）、may/might（可能）、should/ought to（应该）、could have（本可以）、needn't have（没必要做）。
rules: must have + p.p.：过去一定发生了（肯定推测）
may/might/could have + p.p.：过去可能发生（不确定推测）
should/ought to have + p.p.：过去本应做但没做（责备/遗憾）
could have + p.p.：过去本可以做但没做
needn't have + p.p.：过去没必要做但做了（浪费）

examples.en: You should have called me. I was worried.
examples.zh: 你本应该打电话给我的。我很担心。

examples.en: He might have missed the train.
examples.zh: 他可能错过了火车。

examples.en: We needn't have bought so much food.
examples.zh: 我们没必要买这么多食物。

exercises.question: She ___ (could have been / could be) a great singer if she had practiced.
You ___ (needn't have bought / needn't buy) so many gifts.
找出错误并选择正确说法：He should has come earlier.

title: It is...that 强调句型
explanation: It is/was...that/who... 强调句型用于突出句子中的某一成分。可强调主语、宾语、状语，但不能强调谓语。被强调部分放在 It is/was 和 that 之间。判断方法：去掉框架后句子仍然完整。
rules: It is/was + 被强调部分 + that/who + 句子其余部分
强调人时可用 who 代替 that
强调时间、地点、原因仍用 that（不用 when/where/why）
否定强调：It was not until...that...
疑问形式：Was it + 被强调部分 + that...?

examples.en: It was in Paris that we first met.
examples.zh: 我们第一次见面是在巴黎。

examples.en: It is this book that I want to read.
examples.zh: 我想读的就是这本书。

examples.en: Was it you who broke the vase?
examples.zh: 打碎花瓶的人是你吗？

exercises.question: It ___ Tom who called you yesterday.
It was not ___ midnight that he finished the report.
找出错误并选择正确说法：It was in the park where we met.
exercises.answer: It was in the park that we met.
options: It was in the park where we met.
It was in the park that we met.
It was in the park which we met.

title: 连接副词与连接代词
explanation: 连接副词（how, when, where, why）和连接代词（who, whom, what, which, whose）用于引导名词性从句（主语从句、宾语从句、表语从句）。它们既起连接作用，又在从句中充当成分。
rules: who/whom/whose：指人，在从句中作主语/宾语/定语
what/which/whose：指物，在从句中作主语/宾语/定语
when/where/why/how：指时间/地点/原因/方式，在从句中作状语
that 引导从句时不充当成分（可省略于宾语从句）
whether/if 引导是否从句，whether 可接 or not

examples.en: I don't know what he wants.
examples.zh: 我不知道他想要什么。

examples.en: Can you tell me where the station is?
examples.zh: 你能告诉我车站在哪里吗？

examples.en: Whoever finishes first will get a prize.
examples.zh: 谁先完成谁就能得到奖品。

exercises.question: I wonder ___ he will come on time.
Do you know ___ she lives?
找出错误并选择正确说法：I don't know what does he want.
exercises.answer: I don't know what he wants.
options: I don't know what does he want.
I don't know what he wants.
I don't know what he does want.

title: 比较结构（the more...the more）
explanation: the more...the more 结构表示越就越，表达两个变化之间的正比关系。此外还有 no more...than（不比多）、not more...than（不比更）、no less...than（不比少）等复杂比较结构。
rules: the + 比较级, the + 比较级：越越
no more...than：和一样不（两者都否定）
not more...than：不比更（仅否定比较）
no less...than：和一样（两者都肯定）
the + 比较级 + of the two：两者中较的

examples.en: The harder you work, the luckier you get.
examples.zh: 你越努力，就越幸运。

examples.en: He is no richer than I am.
examples.zh: 他和我一样穷。（都不富）

examples.en: The more you read, the more you learn.
examples.zh: 你读得越多，学得就越多。

exercises.question: The ___ (fast) you walk, the ___ (soon) you will arrive.
He is ___ (no smarter / not smarter) than his brother.
把单词排序成正确的句子（比较结构：1. The 2. more 3. you 4. practice 5. the better you become）。
exercises.answer: the more you practice the better you become

title: 否定前置（否定转移）
explanation: 否定前置（否定转移）是指在英语中，某些动词（如 think, believe, expect, suppose, imagine 等）的宾语从句中，否定意义转移到主句谓语动词上。即 I don't think... 而非 I think...not。
rules: I don't think (that) + 陈述句（肯定形式）
类似动词：believe, expect, suppose, imagine, feel
反意疑问句与从句保持一致：I don't think he is, is he?
hope 不发生否定转移：I hope he doesn't come（不说 I don't hope）
否定前移的翻译：中文仍翻译为我认为他不

examples.en: I don't think he will come.
examples.zh: 我认为他不会来。

examples.en: She doesn't believe that he is honest.
examples.zh: 她认为他不诚实。

examples.en: I don't suppose you could help me?
examples.zh: 我想你帮不了我吧？

exercises.question: I ___ (don't think / think not) he is right.
She doesn't believe he ___ (is / isn't) coming.
找出错误并选择正确说法：I think he doesn't like coffee.
exercises.answer: I don't think he likes coffee.
options: I think he doesn't like coffee.
I don't think he likes coffee.
I think not he likes coffee.

title: 部分倒装（高级用法）
explanation: 部分倒装是指将助动词或情态动词提到主语之前。除了否定词前置外，还有 so/neither/nor 引导的倒装、only 状语前置、as 引导的让步状语从句、虚拟条件句省略 if 等情况。
rules: so/neither/nor + 助动词 + 主语：I like coffee. So do I.
only + 状语 + 助动词 + 主语：Only then did I realize...
as 引导让步：Tired as she was, she kept working.
省略 if 的虚拟条件：Had I known = If I had known
so...that 的倒装：So beautiful was the view that...

examples.en: He can swim, and so can I.
examples.zh: 他会游泳，我也会。

examples.en: Hard as he tried, he couldn't solve the problem.
examples.zh: 尽管他努力尝试了，他还是解决不了这个问题。

examples.en: So impressive was the speech that everyone applauded.
examples.zh: 演讲如此精彩，以至于所有人都鼓掌了。

exercises.question: She likes tea and ___ do I.
___ he be late, we will start without him.
找出错误并选择正确说法：He can't swim, so I can't too.
exercises.answer: He can't swim, and neither can I.
options: He can't swim, so I can't too.
He can't swim, and neither can I.
He can't swim, so neither I can.

title: 同位语从句
explanation: 同位语从句用于解释说明前面的抽象名词（如 fact, news, idea, hope, belief, doubt, question, suggestion 等）的具体内容。通常由 that 引导，that 不充当成分，不可省略。与定语从句的区别：同位语从句的 that 从句是对名词的解释，而非修饰。
rules: 抽象名词 + that + 完整陈述句
that 不充当成分，不可省略
常接同位语从句的名词：fact, news, idea, hope, belief, doubt, suggestion, possibility
也可用 whether, what, when, where 等引导
与定语从句区分：同位语从句 = 名词的内容；定语从句 = 名词的特征

examples.en: The news that he won the prize is true.
examples.zh: 他获奖的消息是真的。

examples.en: I have no idea when he will return.
examples.zh: 我不知道他什么时候回来。

examples.en: The fact that she passed the exam surprised everyone.
examples.zh: 她通过考试这件事让所有人都很惊讶。

exercises.question: The news ___ our team won was exciting.
I have no doubt ___ he will succeed.
找出错误并选择正确说法：The idea which he proposed was great.
exercises.answer: The idea that he proposed was great.
options: The idea which he proposed was great.
The idea that he proposed was great.
The idea what he proposed was great.

title: 强调句型（高级变体）
explanation: 除了基本的 It is/was...that 结构外，强调句还有多种高级变体。包括否定强调（It was not until...that...）、疑问强调（Was it...that...）、not until 强调、do/does/did 强调谓语等。这些变体在书面语和口语中都很常见。
rules: It was not until + 时间 + that + 过去式
It is/was not...but...that...（不是而是）
强调谓语：do/does/did + 动词原形
强调句中 It is/was 的时态与从句一致
疑问形式：Was it + 被强调部分 + that...?

examples.en: It was not until midnight that he finished the work.
examples.zh: 他直到半夜才完成工作。

examples.en: I do believe what you said.
examples.zh: 我确实相信你所说的话。

examples.en: Was it in 2020 that the pandemic started?
examples.zh: 疫情是在2020年开始的吗？

exercises.question: It was not ___ she took off her glasses that I recognized her.
She ___ (does / do) look like her mother.
找出错误并选择正确说法：It was not until midnight when he finished.
exercises.answer: It was not until midnight that he finished.
options: It was not until midnight when he finished.
It was not until midnight that he finished.
It was not until midnight he finished.

title: 虚拟语气（第三类）
explanation: 第三类虚拟条件句描述与过去事实相反的假设：if 从句用 had done，主句用 would have done。
rules: if 从句：had + 过去分词
主句：would have + 过去分词
表示“本可以但没发生”

examples.en: If I had known, I would have helped.
examples.zh: 如果我早知道，我就会帮忙了。

examples.en: She would have passed if she had studied.
examples.zh: 如果她学习了，她就会通过考试。

exercises.question: If he had been careful, he ___ the mistake.
找出错误：If I knew, I would have told you yesterday.
exercises.answer: If I had known, I would have told you yesterday
options: If I had known, I would have told you yesterday
If I knew, I would have told you yesterday
If I had known, I would told you yesterday

title: 强调句型 It … that …
explanation: It is/was … that … 结构用于强调句中的某一成分，其余信息不变。
rules: 强调人：It was Tom that broke it
强调物 / 时间 / 地点
去掉 It is…that 后句子仍完整

examples.en: It was Tom who broke the window.
examples.zh: 打碎窗户的是汤姆。

examples.en: It was in 2020 that I graduated.
examples.zh: 我是在 2020 年毕业的。

exercises.question: It was in the garden ___ they met.
找出错误：It is you who is late today.
exercises.answer: It is you who are late today
options: It is you who are late today
It is you who is late today
It was you who are late today

title: 非谓语动词辨析
explanation: 不定式、动名词与分词的选择取决于其在句中的角色：宾语、主语、定语或状语。
rules: 动名词作主语：Swimming is fun
不定式表目的：to succeed
分词作定语：a broken window

examples.en: He enjoys reading before bed.
examples.zh: 他喜欢睡前阅读。

examples.en: To succeed, one must work hard.
examples.zh: 要成功，就必须努力。

exercises.question: ___ (swim) is good for your health.
找出错误：I enjoy to read novels.

title: 状语从句省略
explanation: 状语从句的主语与主句一致且含 be 动词时，可省略从句主语和 be，使句子更简洁。
rules: When (he was) young, he lived in Paris
While (she was) working, she listened to music
省略后句意不变

examples.en: When young, he lived in Paris.
examples.zh: 年轻的时候他住在巴黎。

examples.en: While cooking, she talked on the phone.
examples.zh: 做饭时她打电话。

exercises.question: 找出错误：When was young, he lived in Paris.
exercises.answer: When young, he lived in Paris
options: When young, he lived in Paris
When was young, he lived in Paris
When he young, he lived in Paris

exercises.question: ___ (walk) home, she saw a rainbow.

title: 含蓄条件句（without / but for）
explanation: 用介词短语 without / but for 代替 if 从句表达虚拟条件，主句仍用虚拟语气。
rules: without + 名词：没有…
but for：要不是…
主句用 would have / would 等

examples.en: Without your help, I would have failed.
examples.zh: 没有你的帮助，我早就失败了。

examples.en: But for the rain, we would go out.
examples.zh: 要不是下雨，我们就出去了。

exercises.question: ___ your support, he would not succeed.
找出错误：But for the map, we lost our way.
exercises.answer: But for the map, we would lose our way
options: But for the map, we would lose our way
But for the map, we lost our way
But for the map, we lose our way

title: as if / as though 虚拟
explanation: as if / as though 表示“好像”，所描述内容与事实相反时，从句用过去式或过去完成式。
rules: 与现在相反：动词过去式
与过去相反：had done
be 动词用 were

examples.en: He talks as if he knew everything.
examples.zh: 他说起来好像什么都懂。

examples.en: She acted as if nothing had happened.
examples.zh: 她表现得好像什么都没发生。

exercises.question: He looks as if he ___ (know) us well.
找出错误：She looks as if she was angry.
exercises.answer: She looks as if she were angry
options: She looks as if she were angry
She looks as if she was angry
She looks as if she is angry

title: 主谓一致
explanation: 谓语动词的数须与主语一致，需要注意 a number of（接复数）与 the number of（接单数）等易错点。
rules: a number of + 名词复数 → 复数谓语
the number of + 名词复数 → 单数谓语
就近原则：either…or… 就近取

examples.en: A number of students are late.
examples.zh: 许多学生迟到了。

examples.en: The number of students is growing.
examples.zh: 学生人数在增长。

exercises.question: The number of errors ___ small.
找出错误：Either you or he are wrong.
exercises.answer: Either you or he is wrong
options: Either you or he is wrong
Either you or he are wrong
Either you or he be wrong

title: 地道表达与习语
explanation: 掌握高频习语能让表达更地道，如 by the way（顺便说）、as a matter of fact（事实上）。
rules: by the way：顺便一提
as a matter of fact：事实上
make sense：有道理

examples.en: By the way, are you free tonight?
examples.zh: 顺便问一下，你今晚有空吗？

examples.en: As a matter of fact, I agree with you.
examples.zh: 事实上，我同意你的看法。

exercises.question: ___ , have you seen my keys?
找出错误：This plan does sense.
